title: Bias in the Tails: How Name-conditioned Evaluative Framing in Resume Summaries Destabilizes LLM-based Hiring

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in synthetic resumes using first and last names statistically associated with specific racial groups (White, Black, Hispanic, Asian), followed by an analysis of LLM-generated resume summaries for factual stability, evaluative framing (agency, subjectivity), and simulated downstream hiring decisions.

Counterfactual name substitution in synthetic resumes using names statistically associated with male and female genders across different racial groups, followed by component-level analysis of LLM-generated summaries and downstream hiring evaluations.
